B.pose: Slightly open, nearly together teeth; narrow horizontal opening

C.pose: Medium open mouth, relaxed unrounded lips

D.pose: Wide vertical opening for an open vowel; larger opening than C

E.pose: Slightly rounded lips; opening no wider than C

F.pose: Puckered rounded lips, small forward opening; not a tooth bite

G.pose: Upper teeth touch lower lip; not a wide open vowel

H.pose: Tongue raised behind upper teeth, opening between C and D; tongue may be invisible at native scale

reviewPolicy: Letters alone are insufficient prompts. Require these pose meanings, then inspect actual native art. Distinct hashes/counts and correct timestamps do not prove correct mouth geometry. Emotion changes corners/tension while retaining the pose family; preserve original lip scale and palette.
